objective: Exclude only the immutable BUKLOD Official principal from exact-scope Cluster and Organization lifetime BP Top 10, reranking active ordinary members before pagination while preserving access control and historical records.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-12: GitHub main 6655544e897bae87611cceef49f187ce3e7519c8 at PR branch creation. Live Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu had one canonical protected official, 11 active Cluster/Organization memberships, and separate get_buklod_scope_bp_top10_v1 lacking exclusion. Supabase migration exclude_buklod_official_scope_bp_top10_v2_20261112 applied successfully in production, verified live function predicate and authenticated-only execute grants; rollback-only SQL regression completed successfully. Installed-app/OTA and web runtime were not verified or deployed by this change.
chosenApproach: Use one replacement of the existing membership-authorized SECURITY DEFINER RPC with canonical protected-principal predicate in eligible CTE before row_number. No client changes and no data writes.
selectionRationale: The server already owns the exact-scope ranked query, so server filtering fixes existing and future supported clients without exposing private identities, losing the 10th member, or duplicating ranking logic.
alternativeApproaches: Client-side filter after LIMIT 10: rejected, leaks one slot, cannot protect old clients and risks stale caches.
Remove official from scope memberships or delete historical ledger: rejected, breaks legitimate admin access and audit/history.
Filter in exact-scope RPC before rank: chosen, small and source-of-truth aligned.
acceptanceChecks: All 11 active official Cluster/Organization memberships return Top10 without the Official account via authenticated RPC.
Remaining active members receive continuous ranks 1 through max 10, with deterministic tie ordering.
Other ordinary members retain access to their own scope; anonymous and outsider requests remain denied.
Historical Official BP, status, admin permissions, video playback, advertisements and unrelated leaderboard behavior stay unchanged.
Backend migration is recorded and SQL regression passes; no APK/OTA release implied.
preserveBehaviors: Exact ACTIVE scope membership gating for viewers and rows; the original RPC signature and grants.
Canonical lifetime BP balance ordering, tie-breakers and limit 10.
Official historical points and scope membership without new member reward eligibility.
No changes to Community Wall, video/ads, security principals or unrelated features.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Scope Top 10 SQL output feeds active client UI; exclude the official identity before computed ranks without changing client navigation or render lifecycle.
preservedBehaviors: Same RPC return schema, sorting, active viewer access and server-driven screen refresh.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Replacement SECURITY DEFINER scope ranking function must preserve strict authenticated membership authorization and least-privilege grants.
preservedBehaviors: Anonymous and outsider users remain denied, member scope isolation is unchanged, original historical BP records are retained.
